text:
A question for married couples from the UK. After submitting all our documents online & original,  they asked for a document proving we are registered as a married couple in the UK.  We married through Utah and as expected,  the office in the UK doesn't register these as they are automatically recognized.  
The nice PIBA official explained we can submit an apostilled affidavit from a notary. 
Could anyone advise on the procedure? On a Google search there are so many services and options that we're a bit lost 🤔
